column5: One exact Rust executable serves authenticated raw and actual sysbench prepared traffic through real PD and TiKV, then completes bounded shutdown and tag-owned cleanup; TiDB's full executable startup, configuration, and service lifecycle remain open.

The shared tag-owned lifecycle seeds sixteen exact rows through failpoint-enabled Go TiDB, proves prepared point reads against three real PD and three real TiKV nodes through A-to-B-to-C-to-B churn, and removes only owned state; the broader Go RealTiKV testkit and SQL behavior remain open.
